title: DEFCON 3, 24 to 25 October 1973
zeroNote: H-hour is the WSAG convening at 10:30 p.m. Washington time; times are hours from it

steps.text: DOBRYNIN TELEPHONES BREZHNEV'S MESSAGE: JOINT FORCES TO EGYPT, OR "APPROPRIATE STEPS UNILATERALLY"
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 268, footnote: Dobrynin conveyed the message by phone at 9:35 p.m.

steps.text: KISSINGER TO DOBRYNIN: UNILATERAL ACTION BEFORE A REPLY "WILL BE VERY SERIOUS"
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 268, footnote, 10:15 p.m.

steps.text: WSAG CONVENES IN THE SITUATION ROOM · KISSINGER, SCHLESINGER, COLBY, MOORER, SCOWCROFT, HAIG, HOWE · THE PRESIDENT NOT PRESENT
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 269, Memorandum for the Record, 10:30 p.m.–3:30 a.m.

steps.text: MOORER: 28 AN-22 AND ABOUT 23 AN-12 AVAILABLE TO THE SOVIET AIRLIFT · A CONTINGENT OF 5,000 TO 6,000 MEN DISCUSSED

steps.source: JCS message of 250341Z October 1973, 11:41 p.m. Washington time; Sagan, "Nuclear Alerts and Crisis Management," International Security 9:4 (1985); the memorandum for the record puts the decision at the meeting's start

steps.text: SAC: BOMBERS AND TANKERS TO ALERT · 75 B-52s RECALLED FROM GUAM
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 269: "Recalled 75 B52s from Guam"

steps.text: 82ND AIRBORNE DIVISION ALERTED AT FORT BRAGG
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 269: "Alerted the 82d Airborne Division"

steps.text: JOHN F. KENNEDY ORDERED FROM WEST OF GIBRALTAR INTO THE MEDITERRANEAN · ROOSEVELT FROM SICILY TO JOIN INDEPENDENCE SOUTH OF CRETE · AMPHIBIOUS READY FORCE UNDERWAY FROM SUDA BAY
EUROPEAN FORCES ALERTED · NATO ALLIES NOT CONSULTED
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 269; NSA EBB 98 docs. 79A–B on the North Atlantic Council's complaints

steps.text: NIXON TO SADAT: THE JOINT CONTINGENT IS "A PROPOSAL TO WHICH WE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO AGREE"
steps.source: FRUS 1969–76 vol. XXV doc. 271, backchannel message, 11:55 p.m.

steps.text: WSAG ADJOURNS AT 3:30 A.M. · REPLY TO BREZHNEV DRAFTED
REPLY TO BREZHNEV DELIVERED: JOINT FORCES REJECTED, OBSERVERS ACCEPTED, UNILATERAL ACTION WOULD HAVE "INCALCULABLE CONSEQUENCES"
steps.source: Kissinger, Years of Upheaval (1982); the delivery time is from his account

steps.text: BREZHNEV'S REPLY: OBSERVERS, NOT TROOPS · SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 340 · THE SOVIET STRATEGIC FORCE HAS NOT CHANGED READINESS
steps.source: NSA EBB 98; Sagan 1985 on the absence of any observed Soviet strategic alert
Sagan 1985; SAC history: the stand-down ran over several days from 26 October
Wikipedia, DEFCON, citing the declassified record

guam-recall.note: Seventy-five B-52Ds home from Andersen to their wings; the destination wings are inferred

sixth-fleet.name: USS John F. Kennedy
sixth-fleet.note: West of Gibraltar into the Mediterranean

sixth-fleet.name: USS Franklin D. Roosevelt
sixth-fleet.note: From the vicinity of Sicily to join Independence south of Crete

National Security Archive EBB 98, The October War and U.S. Policy (Burr, 2003)
